title: Driver scheduling system
summary: An eight-week driver rotation and a dispatch board that works out coverage when someone calls in.

title: Paratransit scheduling app
summary: A trip scheduling app for paratransit service, built with Node.js, Express and SQLite.

title: Live vehicle positions feed
summary: A real-time feed of bus locations in GTFS Realtime, the standard format that trip-planning apps read.

title: Real-time bus stop display
summary: A battery-powered e-paper countdown sign for bus stops, prototyped on a $32 CrowPanel ESP32-S3 board.

title: Procurement determination tool
summary: A step-by-step wizard that asks about a purchase and produces the price-reasonableness and small-purchase forms.

title: Bus coloring and story app
summary: A printable coloring page and a story app that makes a kid's own hand-colored bus the hero.

title: LC Transit Simulator
summary: Drive the trolley or a 35 foot bus on the real routes, in a 3D city built from real streets and about 40,000 real building footprints.

title: Sloth Rocket Grand Prix
summary: A 3D kart racer that runs in the browser. Five courses, five karts and split screen for up to four drivers, with Xbox controllers, a wheel and pedals, or the keyboard.

title: River's Rocket Works
summary: Design a rocket and fly twelve missions, from a first launch to a wormhole. It reads the missions out loud, so a kid can play it.

title: Hand-tracking sailing simulator
summary: Sail a Sunfish, an Optimist or a pirate ship by moving your hands in front of the webcam.

title: Sunfish racing notes
summary: Tuning notes for the Sunfish, the only class-legal vang, and how mixed fleets get scored.

title: Learn-to-sail week
summary: A free week of sailing lessons on Sunfish that our yacht club runs every June.

title: F1 wings for the go-kart
summary: A front wing, a two-element rear wing and sidepods for a two-seat Thunder Kart, from plywood and PVC pipe.

title: Comics and books for River
summary: Two picture books about our family and a three-part space comic built on real physics.
